title: Touchscreen Function Introduction Guide
body_html:
Touchscreen Function Introduction

This document offers a comprehensive guide to the functions of each button on the control panel, ensuring a thorough understanding of their operations.

How to Use the Display

Control Panel Button Functions

  1. Start the job
  2. Display of working hours and coordinates of X, Y and Z axes
  3. Stop / cancel the job
  4. Pulse button
  5. Frame button
  6. Autofocus button
  7. Spare button
  8. The laser head moves to the top in the X-axis direction
  9. The laser head moves to the top in the Z-axis direction
  10. The laser head moves to the left in the Y-axis direction
  11. Origin button
  12. The laser head moves to the right in the Y-axis direction
  13. Spare button
  14. The laser head moves down in the X-axis direction
  15. The laser head moves down in the Z-axis direction
  16. Main interface
  17. Menu interface
  18. Memory interface
  19. Reset button

Menu Interface Functions

  1. Enter the IP address setting interface
  2. Enter the switch language interface
  3. Restore factory parameters
  4. Backup current parameters
  5. Enter the Diagnostics interface
  6. Keyboard lock to prevent being touched by mistake
  7. Enter the laser head movement settings interface
  8. Enter the pulse settings interface
  9. System version information interface

Notes

This interface is the memory file interface. Select the file you want to engrave or cut and click “OK”, then it will switch back to the home interface. Click the Start button to run the corresponding job.

The USB flash disk function is not available for the time being.

If any alarm pop-up window triggers, the pop-up window will appear every 1 second after it is closed until the error is resolved.
